safi-cedvel:1-11.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative, a naʿt (adjective) of (المؤمنون); (هم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is (خاشعون); (في صلاتهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; (الواو) is a conjunction in the six places, and the five relative nouns (الذين) are in the position of the nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first relative noun; (عن اللغو) is attached to (معرضون), the khabar; (الزكاة) is genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative in position, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle فاعلون, and (اللام) is the lām of strengthening (lām al-taqwiya) [Note: The lām may be original (aṣliyya), and so attached to (فاعلون).]; (لفروجهم) is like للزكاة; (إلّا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (على أزواجهم) is attached to (حافظين) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of ممسكين ("withholding") [Note: In the speech there is the meaning of negation which must precede (إلّا), because withholding is the absence of giving freely..
The preposition phrase may be a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "except as being in charge of their wives".. and al-Zamakhsharī permitted its attachment to an omitted verb, its implied form being يلامون ("they are blamed").]; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, conjoined to أزواجهم, and (الفاء) in (فإنّهم) is causal (taʿlīliyya), and the (الفاء) after it is a conjunction; (من) is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; (ابتغى) is a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (وراء) is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (ابتغى); (الفاء) links (rābiṭa) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (هم) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position [Note: Or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is العادون.]; (لأماناتهم) is like للزكاة, so الأمانات is an object of (راعون); (على صلواتهم) is attached to (يحافظون); (أولئك هم الوارثون) is like أولئك هم العادون; the last (الذين) is in the position of the nominative, a naʿt of (الوارثون); (فيها) is attached to the khabar (خالدون).
The clause «قد أفلح المؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position, initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «هم.. خاشعون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم.. معرضون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم.. فاعلون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم.. حافظون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the fourth relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ملكت أيمانهم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the fourth relative noun (الذين) [Translator's note: so in the source; the relative noun here is ما].
The clause «إنّهم غير ملومين» has no grammatical position, causal.
The clause «من ابتغى ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّهم غير ...
The clause «ابتغى وراء ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «أولئك هم العادون» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هم العادون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «هم.. راعون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the fifth relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم.. يحافظون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the sixth relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يحافظون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
The clause «أولئك.. الوارثون» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يرثون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the seventh relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم.. خالدون» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) or of the object.

* Morphology:
(8) راعون: plural of راع, the active participle of the triliteral رعى; it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is فاعون.

* Rhetoric:
Antithesis (al-ṭibāq):
That is in the saying of Allah the Exalted «الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلاتِهِمْ خاشِعُونَ، وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ»: an affirmative antithesis (ṭibāq ījāb), for He, glorified is He, combined for the believers in this description doing and abstaining, since He described them by humility in prayer and abstention from idle talk; all of this is semantic affirmative antithesis (ṭibāq al-ījāb al-maʿnawī).

safi-cedvel:12-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) — or a conjunction; (اللام) is the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (من سلالة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلقنا); (من طين) is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (سلالة); (ثمّ) is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī) in the five places; (نطفة) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose governor (ʿāmil) is جعلناه, accusative (manṣūb); (في قرار) is attached to a naʿt of (نطفة) [Note: Or attached to (جعلناه).]; (علقة) is a second mafʿūl bihi whose governor is خلقنا, by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of صيّرنا ("We made into"), and likewise (مضغة وعظاما); (الفاء) is a conjunction; (لحما) is a second mafʿūl bihi whose governor is (كسونا), accusative; (خلقا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the absent (third-person) pronoun, in the sense of مخلوقا ("created"); (آخر) is a naʿt of (خلقا), accusative, and it is prevented from tanwīn because it is an adjective on the pattern أفعل; (الفاء) is for linking the effect to the cause; (أحسن) is a badal (substitute) of the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: It was not parsed as a naʿt of the word of majesty because it has the status of an indefinite, even though it is annexed to الخالقين, for the latter is in the sense of من, i.e. "better than whoever created".. Abū al-Baqāʾ permitted it to be the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject)..]; (بعد) is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to (ميّتون); (يوم) is an adverb, accusative, attached to (تبعثون).
The clause «خلقنا ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the implied oath.. and the implied oath clause is resumptive — or conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the initial (ibtidāʾiyya) clause — and the clause «جعلناه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقنا..
The clause «خلقنا النطفة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause جعلناه.
The clause «خلقنا العلقة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقنا النطفة.
The clause «خلقنا المضغة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقنا العلقة.
The clause «كسونا العظام ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقنا المضغة.
The clause «أنشأناه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كسونا..
The clause «تبارك الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنشأناه.. [Note: Or resumptive, of supplication (duʿāʾiyya).].
The clause «إنّكم ... لميّتون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنشأناه.
The clause «إنّكم.. تبعثون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنكم لميّتون.
The clause «تبعثون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(2) سلالة: a noun for what is drawn out (ustulla) of a thing, or in the sense of the extract (khulāṣa) of a thing; it is in the sense of "the thing drawn out" (al-shayʾ al-maslūl); its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word is on the pattern فُعالة].

* Rhetoric:
Figurative usage (al-majāz):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «فِي قَرارٍ مَكِينٍ», His saying «فِي قَرارٍ» means "a place of settling" (mustaqarr); it is so called by way of hyperbole, and what is meant by it is the womb; and He described it by His saying «مكين», i.e. "firmly settled", which here is the sperm-drop (al-nuṭfa), by way of figurative usage, as one says طريق سائر ("a travelling road"). It was also permitted to say that the womb itself is firmly settled, and the meaning of its being firmly settled is that it does not detach, because of the weight of what it carries, or does not expel what is in it; so it is an allusion (kināya) to making the sperm-drop guarded and protected.

* Benefits:
- The disparity of the conjunctions:
All of us know that each of the conjunctions has a meaning; for example, «ثمّ» is for delay (tarākhī), «الفاء» for immediate succession (taʿqīb), and «أو» for equivalence, etc. But there are other considerations which we must grasp and give their role in establishing those differences between the particles; among them is the close connection between the two periods of the conjoined (al-maʿṭūf) and that to which it is conjoined (al-maʿṭūf ʿalayhi), even if the duration of each of them is long.
And among them is the rational distance between the two members of the conjunction, even if their durations are close; for rational unlikelihood makes the period of conjunction take the place of delay in time, and the conjunction الفاء was replaced by the conjunction «ثم». This subject has subtleties and fine considerations worthy of study, if the plan of the book allowed it.

safi-cedvel:17-22.t:
* I'rab:
(لقد خلقنا): its i'rab has already been given [Note: In verse (12) of this sūra.]; (فوقكم) is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلقنا); (طرائق) is a diptote, because it is a plural on the pattern of the ultimate plurals (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ); (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) — or a conjunction; (ما) is negating, inoperative (muhmala); (عن الخلق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) (غافلين).
The clause «خلقنا ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the implied (muqaddar) oath.. and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) — or conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding implied oath clause [Note: In verse (12) of this sūra.].
The clause «ما كنّا.. غافلين» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of خلقنا [Note: Or conjoined to the response to the oath.].
18- (الواو) is a conjunction; (من السماء) is attached to (أنزلنا); (بقدر) is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil [Note: Or attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ماء, i.e. "being in measure", i.e. measured out.]; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (في الأرض) is attached to (أسكنّاه); (الواو) is a conjunction — or circumstantial; (على ذهاب) is attached to the khabar (قادرون); (به) is attached to (ذهاب), and (الباء) is for transitivity (taʿdiya); (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis.
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.
The clause «أسكنّاه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنزلنا.
The clause «إنّا.. لقادرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أسكنّاه [Note: Or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); and it may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil or of the object in (أسكنّاه).].
19- (الفاء) is a conjunction; (لكم) is attached to (أنشأنا); (به) is attached to (أنشأنا), and (الباء) is causal (sababiyya); (من نخيل) is attached to a naʿt of (جنّات); the second (لكم) is attached to a fronted khabar; (فيها) is attached to the "being settled" (al-istiqrār) which is the khabar [Note: It may be attached to a ḥāl of فواكه — a naʿt placed before what it qualifies.], and the mubtadaʾ (subject) is (فواكه); (الواو) is a conjunction; (منها) is attached to (تأكلون).
The clause «أنشأنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أسكنّاه.
The clause «لكم فيها فواكه ...» is in the position of the accusative, a naʿt of جنّات [Note: Or it is a ḥāl of جنّات, because it has been qualified by the preposition and its genitive noun (من نخيل).].
The clause «تأكلون» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لكم فيها فواكه.
20- (الواو) is a conjunction; (شجرة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being أنشأنا; (من طور) is attached to (تخرج); (سيناء) is a diptote because of being a proper name and feminine — or a feminine ending in the extended alif of femininity (alif al-taʾnīth al-mamdūda); (بالدهن) is attached to (تنبت), and (الباء) is for transitivity; (صبغ) is conjoined to الدهن by the wāw, genitive (majrūr); (للآكلين) is attached to a naʿt of (صبغ), and the sign of its genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «(أنشأنا) شجرة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the mentioned clause أنشأنا.
The clause «تخرج ...» is in the position of the accusative, a naʿt of شجرة.
The clause «تنبت ...» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تخرج.
21- 22- (الواو) is a conjunction; (لكم) is attached to the khabar of inna; (في الأنعام) is attached to a ḥāl of (عبرة) [Note: Or attached to the "being settled" which is the khabar.], and (اللام) is the lām of the inchoative (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis; (عبرة) is the postponed ism of inna, accusative; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by (من), attached to (نسقيكم); (في بطونها) is attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الواو) is a conjunction; (لكم فيها ... تأكلون) is like the previous one; (الواو) is a conjunction; (عليها) is attached to the passive تحملون, and likewise (على الفلك).
The clause «إنّ لكم.. لعبرة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied oath clause.
The clause «نسقيكم ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لكم فيها منافع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نسقيكم.
The clause «منها تأكلون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نسقيكم.
The clause «عليها.. تحملون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نسقيكم.

* Morphology:
(17) طرائق: plural of طريقة.. see verse (63) of Sūrat Ṭā Hā.
(18) ذهاب: an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb ذهب; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ; there is another maṣdar, ذهوب, with ḍamma on the dhāl.
(20) سيناء: a noun of place for the well-known desert; its pattern is فيعال; it contains the substitution (ibdāl) of its lām — which is the yāʾ — into hamza, because it comes at the end after a quiescent extra alif.
(20) الدهن: a noun for the pressed juice of anything containing fat; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(20) صبغ: a noun for that with which a thing is dyed; its plural is أصباغ; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.
(آكلين): plural of آكل, the active participle of the triliteral أكل; its pattern is فاعل and the plural فاعلين; the hamza was merged with the quiescent alif of فاعل and a madda was placed over it.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَصِبْغٍ لِلْآكِلِينَ», where liquid condiment is likened to dye; then the thing likened (al-mushabbah) was omitted and the thing likened to (al-mushabbah bihi) was retained, the common ground being taking on its colour when dipped in it.

* Benefits:
1- Emphasis (al-tawkīd):
The discerning observer of the styles of the Qur'an notices that emphasis is a basic sinew in the style of the Noble Qur'an. Look at verse 18 (وَإِنَّا عَلى ذَهابٍ بِهِ لَقادِرُونَ): this passage contains a number of devices of emphasis, the first of them: (أنّ) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse has إنّا]; the second: the fronting of the khabar «عَلى ذَهابٍ» before the mubtadaʾ; the third: the redundant preposition «به» [Translator's note: so in the source, although the i'rab above makes this bāʾ one of transitivity, and عَلى ذَهابٍ is attached to the khabar قادرون rather than being a fronted khabar]; the fourth: «the shifted lām of قادرون». We can say the like of that about the saying of Allah the Exalted «إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعامِ لَعِبْرَةً», which contains three emphasisers. The like of that is abundant in the Noble Qur'an, for whoever observes its outward form. Its explanation differs with the difference of the sūras and their subjects. Perhaps among the first of these reasons is the obstinacy of the polytheists, the hypocrites and the People of the Book who were the subject of these addresses; and among them too is the strength of the proof against them, and its establishment before them, on His part, exalted is He. So is there anyone who will take heed?!
2- طور سيناء is the very same as طور سينين:
Either it is an annexational compound (murakkab iḍāfī), like امرئ القيس and بعلبك, and it is a diptote.
Or «طور» is the name of the mountain, and it has been annexed to a region named «سيناء», which is known as «the Sinai Desert»; it is an extension of Palestine up to the Suez Canal, and it is the desert of wandering (al-tīh) in which the people of Mūsā wandered for forty years. As for the tree, it is the olive tree, because its cultivation became famous in this region of the lands of al-Shām.

safi-cedvel:23-23.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (لقد أرسلنا نوحا): the i'rab of its parallel has already been given [Note: In verse (12) of this sūra.]; (إلى قومه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا); (الفاء) is a conjunction; (يا قوم) is a vocative particle and the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ, which is deleted for lightness (takhfīf).. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ما) is negating, inoperative (muhmala); (لكم) is attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (إله) is genitive (majrūr) in form and nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (غيره) is a naʿt (adjective) of إله, following its position, and so nominative; (الهمزة) is for the interrogative of rebuke (tawbīkhī); (الفاء) is a conjunction..
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the implied (muqaddar) oath.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the response clause.
The clause «the vocative and its response ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اعبدوا ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the vocative.
The clause «ما لكم من إله ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) — and the clause «تتّقون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
"Have you disobeyed, so that you do not fear (Allah)?"

safi-cedvel:24-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative, a naʿt (adjective) of الملأ; (من قومه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of كفروا; (ما) is negating, inoperative (muhmala); (إلّا) is for restriction (ḥaṣr); (بشر) is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هذا); (مثلكم) is a naʿt of بشر, nominative (marfūʿ); (عليكم) is attached to (يتفضّل).
The interpreted maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-muʾawwal) (أن يتفضّل) is in the position of the accusative, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose governor (ʿāmil) is يريد..
(الواو) is a conjunction; (اللام) occurs in the response of لو; (بهذا) is attached to (سمعنا); (في آبائنا) is attached to (سمعنا) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "in the reports of our fathers" [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the demonstrative.].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ما هذا إلّا بشر ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يريد ...» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of بشر [Note: Because the indefinite here has been qualified; and the clause may be a naʿt of بشر, in the position of the nominative.].
The clause «يتفضّل ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «لو شاء الله ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the object of the saying.
The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
The clause «ما سمعنا ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
25- (إن) is negating; (إلّا) is for restriction; (رجل) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو); (به) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (جنّة); (الفاء) links (rābiṭa) the apodosis of an implied condition; (به) is attached to (تربّصوا), and likewise (حتّى حين).
The clause «إن هو إلّا رجل ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «به جنّة ...» is in the position of the nominative, a naʿt of رجل.
The clause «تربّصوا ...» is in the position of the jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you want to know his reality, then wait".

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّ) is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ, which is deleted for lightness (takhfīf), and the deleted (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī), and (النون) is for protection (al-wiqāya).. and the deleted (الياء) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The interpreted maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-muʾawwal) (ما كذّبون..) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (انصرني), and (الباء) is causal (sababiyya).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «ربّ انصرني ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «انصرني ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the vocative.
The clause «كذّبون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is a conjunction; (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحينا); (أن) is explicative (tafsīriyya); (بأعيننا) is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of اصنع, and (الباء) is for accompaniment (mulābasa); and (الفاء) in (فاسلك) links (rābiṭa) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (فيها) is attached to (اسلك) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of أدخل ("bring in"); (من كلّ) is attached to (اسلك); (اثنين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ; (إلّا) is for exception; (من) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative, excepted (mustathnā) by إلّا; (عليه) is attached to (سبق); (منهم) is a ḥāl of the pronoun in (عليه); (لا) is prohibitive, making jussive (nāhiya jāzima); (في الذين) is attached to (تخاطبني) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "concerning the matter of those who"..
The clause «أوحينا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause قال [Note: In the previous verse (26).].
The clause «اصنع ...» has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «جاء أمرنا ...» is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «فار التنّور ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause جاء أمرنا.
The clause «اسلك ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
The clause «سبق عليه القول» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «لا تخاطبني ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّهم مغرقون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Benefits:
- «فَأَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ»:
This is perhaps the third time we point to the occurrences of the explicative «أن» (an al-tafsīriyya), which is the one that occurs after a clause containing the meaning of saying without its letters. The verb «أوحى» contains the meaning of saying, and contains none of its letters.
This pointer suffices to prompt the reader to revisit this subject in its proper sources.

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is a conjunction; (أنت) is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, a tawkīd (emphasis) of the attached pronoun, the tāʾ; (الواو) is a conjunction; (من) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun that is the fāʿil (agent) of استويت; (معك) is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من; (على الفلك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استويت); (الفاء) links (rābiṭa) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لله) is attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الحمد); (الذي) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla); (من القوم) is attached to (نجّانا).
The clause «استويت ...» is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
The clause «الحمد لله ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نجّانا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
29- (الواو) is a conjunction; (ربّ أنزلني) is like ربّ انصرني [Note: In verse (26) of this sūra.]; (منزلا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, if it is a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī).
(3, 4) Or resumptive, and the clause after it is a causal resumption (istiʾnāf taʿlīlī).] [Translator's note: so in the source; footnotes 3 and 4 have been run into this note]; (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (3).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the (first) clause قل.
The clause «the vocative and its response ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying.
The clause «أنزلني ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنت خير ...» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of أنزلني (4).

* Benefits:
- The story of Nūḥ:
We shall content ourselves with the last part of this story and leave the whole of it to another place.
«فَأَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنا وَوَحْيِنا»: When he saw that Allah's word had been realised and His revelation had decreed that no one would believe in him any more, that their hearts had been sealed and locks placed upon them, so that they would no longer submit to proof or yield to faith, he said: «رَبِّ لا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ دَيَّاراً إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبادَكَ وَلا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فاجِراً كَفَّاراً».
So Allah answered his prayer and revealed to him: «اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنا وَوَحْيِنا وَلا تُخاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ». He took a place far from the town and set about preparing planks and nails, but he did not escape the mockery and ridicule of the people.
Some of them said: You, Nūḥ, used to claim before today that you are a prophet and a messenger; how have you become a carpenter today? And others said: What is the matter with you, building the ship far from the seas and rivers? But he turned away from their ridicule and their idle talk.
Then Allah revealed to him: When Our command comes and Our signs appear, then go to your ship, take those of your people and your family who believed, and carry with you of every kind two, a pair, until Allah's command is fulfilled.
The gates of heaven were opened with water, the springs of the earth burst forth, the flood reached its peak (balagha al-saylu al-zubā), then went beyond the plains and the hills; Nūḥ hurried to the ship and carried what Allah had commanded him to carry, of humans, animals and plants, and it sailed — in the name of Allah be its course and its mooring.
The ship sailed in a gentle wind, while the waves opened graves for the unbelievers among their folds, and the foam stitched shrouds for them; they struggled against death and death overcame them; they wrestled the waves but the waves threw them down, until the waves folded them away as a secret is folded away in the heart. This is one chapter of the chapters of the story of Nūḥ which we have conveyed to you, as it came in the lengthy works and the Stories of the Qur'an; and we shall return to the life of Nūḥ in other places in this book, with His help, exalted is He.
2- هيهات has many dialectal forms (lughāt): it is well known with fatḥa on the tāʾ, as indeclinable (mabnī), which is the dialect of the Ḥijāzīs; among its forms are هيهاتا, and هيهات and هيهات with kasra and with tanwīn, then the three without tanwīn, then with sukūn on the tāʾ. It is permissible to substitute hamza for the first hāʾ in all the dialects mentioned. [Translator's note: the source lists the forms without vowel marks, so the distinctions it intends are not all visible in the text; also, هيهات occurs in verse 36, not in this range]
The noun after it occurs in the nominative by it, just as it is made nominative by a verb, because it functions like the verb, and so requires a fāʿil. Jarīr said:
فهيهات هيهات العقيق ومن به ... وهيهات خلّ بالعقيق نواصله
(How far, how far is al-ʿAqīq and whoever is in it, and how far a friend at al-ʿAqīq with whom we keep company.)

safi-cedvel:30-32.t:
* I'rab:
(في ذلك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; (اللام) is for emphasis; (آيات) is the ism of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the kasra; (الواو) is a conjunction; (إن) is lightened from the heavy (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its ism is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (اللام) is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa); (مبتلين) is the khabar of كنّا, accusative.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات» has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «إن (هـ) كنّا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كنّا لمبتلين) is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the lightened إن.
31- (من بعدهم) is attached to (أنشأنا); (آخرين) is a naʿt (adjective) of قرن, accusative, and it is according to the meaning of "a people", the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «أنشأنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to إن كنّا ...
32- (الفاء) is a conjunction; (فيهم) is attached to (أرسلنا); (منهم) is attached to a naʿt of (رسولا); (أن) is explicative (mufassira) (1); (اعبدوا الله ... تتّقون): its i'rab has already been given [Note: In verse (23) of this sūra.]. [Translator's note: the footnote markers (1) and (3) in this entry have no corresponding footnote text in the source]
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنشأنا.
The clause «اعبدوا ...» has no grammatical position, explicative (tafsīriyya) (3).
The clause «ما لكم من إله ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) — and the clause «تتّقون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption confirming what precedes it.

safi-cedvel:33-38.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (قال الملأ ... كفروا): the i'rab of its parallel has already been given (1); (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places; (بلقاء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا); (في الحياة) is attached to (أترفناهم); (ما هذا ... مثلكم): its i'rab has already been given (2) [Translator's note: the footnote markers (1) and (2) have no corresponding footnote text in the source; the parallel is in verse 24]; (ممّا) is attached to (يأكل); (منه) is attached to (تأكلون); the second (ممّا) is attached to (يشرب).
The clause «قال الملأ ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أترفناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «ما هذا إلّا بشر ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يأكل ...» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of بشر [Note: Because the indefinite here has been qualified ... and it may be resumptive, and so have no grammatical position.].
The clause «تأكلون منه ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يشرب ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause يأكل.
The clause «تشربون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
34- (الواو) is a conjunction; (اللام) is the lām preparing for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) is a jussive conditional particle; (أطعتم) is a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (مثلكم) is a naʿt (adjective) of (بشرا), accusative (manṣūb); (إذا) — with tanwīn — is a particle of response with no governing effect; (اللام) is the lām of the oath, in compensation for the shifted lām (al-muzaḥlaqa); (خاسرون) is the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «إن أطعتم ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ما هذا إلّا بشر.
The clause «إنّكم.. لخاسرون» has no grammatical position, the response to the oath.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
35- (الهمزة) is for the interrogative of astonishment (taʿajjubī), and the fāʿil (agent) of (يعدكم) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), i.e. the Messenger; the khabar of the first (أنكم) is (مخرجون), and (أنّكم) was repeated for emphasis because of the length of the separation [Note: The khabar may be omitted, indicated by the khabar of the second (أنّكم), and the second interpreted maṣdar is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first or a badal (substitute); or the second interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is the adverb before it, and the clause is then the khabar of the first (أنكم), i.e.: "Does he promise you that you — your being brought out is at the time of your death"..; or the second interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being يحدث ("occurs"), which is the response of إذا, and the clause of the adverb, its condition and its response is the khabar of the first (أنّكم).] ...
The interpreted maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-muʾawwal) (أنّكم ... مخرجون) is in the position of the accusative, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose governor (ʿāmil) is يعدكم.
(إذا) is an adverb (ẓarf) which may carry the meaning of a condition, so the response is omitted and the adverb is attached to it; or it may be a pure adverb, attached to what the khabar of أنّكم indicates; (الواو) is a conjunction in both places.
The clause «يعدكم ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «متمّ ...» is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «كنتم ترابا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause متّم.
36- (هيهات) is a verbal noun of the past (ism fiʿl māḍin) in the sense of بعد ("is far"); the second (هيهات) is a tawkīd of the first; (اللام) is redundant (zāʾida) [Note: Some parsers permitted the lām to be explanatory (li-l-bayān), attached to an omitted element which is the fāʿil of هيهات, i.e. "the believing, or the occurrence, of what you are promised is far".. or it is attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هيهات), by its being a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "farness belongs to what you are promised"; this is the view of al-Zajjāj.]. (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī) [Note: Or a relative noun with the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) omitted.. and the clause توعدون is the ṣila of the relative noun.]; (توعدون) is a passive imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما توعدون..) has as its remoter position the fāʿil of هيهات.. and as its nearer position the genitive by the lām, i.e. "the Messenger's promise of your being brought out after death is far".
The clause «هيهات ... لما توعدون» has no grammatical position, resumptive, confirming the content of what preceded within the scope of the previous saying.
37- (إن) is negating; (إلّا) is for restriction (ḥaṣr); (حياتنا) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هي); (الواو) is a conjunction; (ما) is negating, operating like ليس; (نحن) is its ism; (مبعوثين) is genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative in position, the khabar of ما, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «إن هي إلّا حياتنا ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «نموت ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the pronoun in حياتنا.].
The clause «نحيا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نموت.
The clause «ما نحن بمبعوثين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نموت.
38 (إن هو إلّا رجل) is like إن هي إلّا حياتنا; (على الله) is attached to (افترى); (كذبا) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: If it denotes the thing lied about; or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being synonymous with it.]; (الواو) is a conjunction; (ما نحن له بمؤمنين) is like ما نحن بمبعوثين.. (له) is attached to (مؤمنين).
The clause «إن هو إلّا رجل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive within the scope of the saying.
The clause «افترى ...» is in the position of the nominative, a naʿt of رجل.
The clause «ما نحن له بمؤمنين» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause افترى.

* Morphology:
(هيهات): a verbal noun of the past (ism fiʿl māḍin) whose meaning is بعد ("is far").

* Benefits:
1- The verse «أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُراباً وَعِظاماً أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ».
The grammarians have several views on the i'rab of this verse, especially regarding the khabar of the first «أن» and the second أن.
We choose for you the preponderant view among the imams of grammar, with which the soul is at ease and in which the mind finds rest, namely that the second «أنّ» is a repetition and tawkīd of the first after the separation became long, and that the word «مخرجون» is the khabar of the first «أن»; this is what al-Jarmī, al-Mubarrad and al-Farrāʾ held, and it agrees with the craft of grammar and the rules of the language..
2- Concerning this verse:
Ibn Abī al-Ḥadīd wrote a commentary on Nahj al-Balāgha, and in his commentary he cited the following: The Chief Judge (Qāḍī al-Quḍāt) said: None of the rational people held the denial of the Maker of the world; but a group of the copyists (al-warrāqūn) gathered and composed among themselves a doctrine which no one had held, namely that the world is eternal (qadīm), has always been in this form of its, that the world has no god and no maker at all, and that it has always been and will always be thus without a maker or an agent. Among the most famous of the Arabs who adopted this doctrine was Ibn al-Rāwandī; he took up this doctrine and spread it in his book known as Kitāb al-Tāj.
Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-Maʿarrī mentioned Ibn al-Rāwandī and his Tāj in Risālat al-Ghufrān, and among what he said:
«As for Ibn al-Rāwandī, he was not guided to what is beneficial; and as for his Tāj (crown), it is not fit to be a sandal. Is his Tāj anything but as the soothsayer woman said»: «أفّ وتفّ وجورب وخف» ("Fie and pooh, a sock and a boot"). And concerning these people Abū al-ʿAlāʾ says in his Luzūmiyyāt:
ضل الذي قال البلاد قديمة ... بالطبع كانت والأنام كبنتها
(He has gone astray who said the lands are eternal, existing by nature, and mankind like their offspring.)
وأمامنا يوم تقوم هجوده ... من بعد إبلاء العظام ورفتها
(And before us is a day when its sleepers will rise, after the bones have decayed and crumbled.)
May Allah have mercy on al-Maʿarrī: had he lived to our days, he would have seen thousands and millions of copyists and Rāwandīs proclaiming the doctrine of those people openly, finding no one to prune their doctrine or belittle their opinions, for they have become possessed of power and strength.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
See its i'rab, words and clauses, previously [Note: In verse (26) of this sūra.].

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) is redundant (zāʾida); (عن قليل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نادمين) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted (ننصر).]; (اللام) is the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (يصبحنّ) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn.. it was deleted because of the succession of like letters (tawālī al-amthāl), and (الواو), deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the ism of يصبح, and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; (نادمين) is the khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «يصبحنّ ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the implied oath.. and the implied oath clause is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

safi-cedvel:41-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (بالحقّ) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الصيحة; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (غثاء) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), whose governor (ʿāmil) is جعلناهم; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (بعدا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. ابعدوا بعدا ("be far removed, a removal"); (للقوم) is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being قلنا [Note: Or it is the khabar (predicate) of a necessarily omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the imprecation is for the people".. or attached to the maṣdar (بعدا) according to the view of Abū Ḥayyān; see verse (44) of Sūrat Hūd.].
The clause «أخذتهم الصيحة ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or conjoined to an implied resumption.].
The clause «جعلناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause أخذتهم الصيحة.
The clause «(ابعدوا) بعدا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of the implied saying..
and the implied saying clause has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أخذتهم الصيحة.
42- (ثمّ) is a conjunction; (من بعدهم) is attached to (أنشأنا).
The clause «أنشأنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أخذتهم الصيحة.
43- (ما) is negating; (أمّة) is genitive (majrūr) in form and nominative in position, the fāʿil (agent) of تسبق..
The clause «ما تسبق من أمّة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنشأنا [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of (قرونا), with the linking pronoun implied, i.e. فيها ("in them").. and it may be a ḥāl.].
The clause «ما يستأخرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما تسبق.
44- (تترى) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "following one another" [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, explaining its kind.]; (كلّما) is an adverbial compound containing the meaning of a condition, attached to the response كذّبوه; (أمّة) is a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (بعضا) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, whose governor is أتبعنا; (الواو) is a conjunction; (أحاديث) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, whose governor is جعلناهم, and it is prevented from tanwīn because it is on the pattern of the ultimate plurals (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ); (الفاء) is a conjunction; (بعدا لقوم لا يؤمنون) is like بعدا للقوم الظالمين.. and (لا) is negating.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنشأنا.
The clause «جاء أمّة رسولها ...» is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī), and the interpreted maṣdar (ما جاء..) is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.].
The clause «كذّبوه ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
The clause «أتبعنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أرسلنا.
The clause «جعلناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أتبعنا.
The clause «(ابعدوا) بعدا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying of an implied saying, and the implied saying is conjoined to the clause جعلناهم ...
The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» is in the position of the genitive, a naʿt of قوم.
45- (هارون) is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of (أخاه) — or a badal (substitute) of it — accusative; (بآياتنا) is attached to a ḥāl of موسى..
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أرسلنا رسلنا.
46- (إلى فرعون) is attached to (أرسلنا); it is a diptote because of being a proper name and foreign (al-ʿalamiyya wa-l-ʿujma); (الفاء) is a conjunction..
The clause «استكبروا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أرسلنا موسى.
The clause «كانوا قوما ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استكبروا.
47- (الفاء) is a conjunction; (الهمزة) is for the interrogative of astonishment (taʿajjubī); (لبشرين) is attached to (نؤمن); (مثلنا) is a naʿt of بشرين, genitive like it [Note: It came in the singular, the singular sufficing for the dual.]; (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لنا) is attached to (عابدون), the khabar.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استكبروا.
The clause «نؤمن ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying.
The clause «قومهما لنا عابدون» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl.
48- (الفاء) is a conjunction in both places; (من المهلكين) is attached to the khabar of كانوا ...
The clause «كذّبوهما ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كذّبوهما.
49- (الواو) is a conjunction; (اللام) is the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (الكتاب) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the pronoun in (لعلّهم) refers to the people of Mūsā.
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the oath.
The clause «لعلّهم يهتدون» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يهتدون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of لعلّ.
50- (الواو) is a conjunction in the four places; (آية) is a second mafʿūl bihi whose governor is جعلنا; (إلى ربوة) is attached to (آويناهما); (ذات) is a naʿt of ربوة, genitive; (معين) is conjoined to قرار, genitive, and it is a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "flowing water".
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا موسى..
The clause «آويناهما ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause جعلنا..
51- (أيّ) is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative.. and (ها) is a particle for drawing attention (tanbīh); (الرسل) is a badal of أيّ, or an ʿaṭf bayān, following it in the nominative in form (lafẓan); (من الطيّبات) is attached to (كلوا); (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun, in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, with the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) omitted, i.e. تعملونه, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما.]..
The interpreted maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-muʾawwal) (ما تعملون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (عليم), the khabar of inna.
The clause «the vocative ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption confirming what preceded.
The clause «كلوا ...» has no grammatical position, the response to the vocative.
The clause «اعملوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «إنّي.. عليم» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption — or a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of what preceded — and the clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).

* Morphology:
(41) غثاء: an underived (jāmid) noun for dried vegetation; its pattern is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ; its plurals are أغثية and غثيان with kasra on the ghayn, like غراب, أغربة and غربان.. it contains the conversion (qalb) of its lām — the wāw — into hamza, for it is from غثا يغثو, since it came at the end after a quiescent alif.
(44) تترى: a maṣdar, and the first (التاء) in it is converted from a wāw; its origin is وترى, because the word is from الوتر or from المواترة; and (الألف) is either added for attachment (li-l-ilḥāq), as in أرطى, or it is for femininity. As for its spelling, it has been written in the Muṣḥaf long — contrary to the orthographic norm — and that is to suit the reading with tanwīn [Translator's note: the source has قراء, evidently a misprint for قراءة].
(46) عالين: plural of عال; see verse (83) of Sūrat Yūnus; عالين contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, starting from the singular, because of the meeting of the quiescence of the weak letter with the quiescence of the tanwīn.
(48) المهلكين: plural of المهلك, the passive participle of the quadriliteral أهلك; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(50) معين: passive participle of the triliteral عان, whose imperfect is يعين; so it is on the pattern of مبيع, and the mīm is extra; its origin is معيون; iʿlāl entered it, in that the yāʾ was made quiescent and its vowel transferred to the ʿayn — iʿlāl by quiescence (taskīn) — then the wāw was deleted because it is extra, so it became معين — with ḍamma on the ʿayn — iʿlāl by deletion; then the ʿayn was given kasra to suit the yāʾ, so it became معين with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. It was also said that the mīm is original, so its pattern is فعيل, derived from the triliteral معن in the sense of "flowed and was swift".

* Benefits:
1- The shortened alif of تترى: there are three views about it:
a- It is for attachment (ilḥāq) to «جعفر», and it is like the alif in «أرطى».
b- It is a substitute for the tanwīn. c- It is for femininity, like سكرى; on this view it is a diptote and does not take tanwīn.
Its meaning is «following one after another».
2- كلما: it is an adverb containing the meaning of a condition, and it conveys repetition; we have alluded to that previously.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is a conjunction in both places; (أمّة) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūba), of أمّتكم [Note: The ḥāl came as an underived (jāmid) noun because it has been qualified.]; (الفاء) is a conjunction for linking the effect to the cause, and the nūn in (فاتّقون) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), coming before the first-person yāʾ, which is deleted to suit the endings of the verses.
The clause «إنّ هذه أمّتكم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the response to the vocative [Note: In the previous verse (51); and it may be resumptive.].
The clause «أنا ربّكم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ هذه أمّتكم.
The clause «اتّقون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: "Take heed, and so fear Me".

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (بينهم) is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقطّعوا); (زبرا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of تقطّعوا, accusative; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فرحون), and (ما) is a relative noun; (لديهم) is an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما.
The clause «تقطّعوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كلّ حزب.. فرحون» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil in تقطّعوا.. or it is a naʿt (adjective) of (زبرا).].

safi-cedvel:54-56.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) links (rābiṭa) the apodosis of an implied condition; (في غمرتهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ذرهم) [Note: Or to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), if the verb (ذرهم) is one of the verbs of becoming (afʿāl al-ṣayrūra).]; (حتّى حين) is attached to (ذرهم).
The clause «ذرهم ...» is in the position of the jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if they rejoice in what they have, then leave them".
55 (الهمزة) is for the interrogative of rebuke (taqrīʿī); (ما) is a relative noun, the ism of anna, in the position of the accusative [Note: In the Muṣḥaf (أنّما) is written joined, though it ought properly to be separated, because (ما) is a relative noun, as evidenced by the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) returning to it in (به), or by its being explained in (من مال).]; (به) is attached to (نمدّهم); (من مال) is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in به [Note: Or it is a tamyīz (specification) of the relative noun (ما).].
The clause «يحسبون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «نمدّهم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
56- (لهم) is attached to (نسارع), and likewise (في الخيرات); (بل) is for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī); (لا) is negating.
The clause «نسارع ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of anna. The linking pronoun is implied, i.e. "We hasten with it for them".
The interpreted maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-muʾawwal) (أنّ ما نمدّهم.. نسارع) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يحسبون.
The clause «لا يشعرون ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) of the interrogative of rebuke.

* Benefits:
- أَنَّما نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مالٍ وَبَنِينَ:
The spelling of «أنما» occurs in the Qur'an joined, as though it were one word, and as though «ما» were the restraining (kāffa) one, as in كأنما. But in reality they are two words: أنّ, a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), and ما, a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdar) [Translator's note: so in the source, although the i'rab above makes ما a relative noun]; and to distinguish between it and the redundant one, this one is written separately and that one is written joined.

safi-cedvel:57-62.t:
* I'rab:
(من خشية) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) (مشفقون), and the three (relative nouns) are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first relative noun by conjunctions, in the position of the accusative; (بآيات) is attached to (يؤمنون); (بربّهم) is attached to the negated (يشركون); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative, a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose governor (ʿāmil) is يؤتون, and the first object is omitted, i.e. "people"; (الواو) is the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (إلى ربّهم) is attached to the khabar of anna (راجعون); (في الخيرات) is attached to (يسارعون); (الواو) is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لها) is attached to (سابقون); (الواو) is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; (إلّا) is for restriction (ḥaṣr); (وسعها) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), whose governor is نكلّف [Note: This is by way of extension (tajawwuz), because the original speech is: "We do not charge a soul except with a matter which it has the capacity to carry out"; when the second object was omitted, the genitive noun took its place — by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) — and so it was parsed as a second object by way of latitude (ʿalā al-saʿa).]; (الواو) is a conjunction; (لدينا) is an adverb (ẓarf), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (كتاب); (بالحقّ) is attached to (ينطق); (الواو) is a conjunction or circumstantial; (لا) is negating.
The interpreted maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-muʾawwal) (أنّهم ... راجعون) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. لأنهم ("because they") or بأنهم ("that they").. attached to (وجلة).
The clause «إنّ الذين ... أولئك يسارعون» has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «هم.. مشفقون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم ... يؤمنون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يؤمنون ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
The clause «هم ... لا يشركون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا يشركون ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the third mubtadaʾ (هم).
The clause «يؤتون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the fourth relative noun (الذين).
The clause «آتوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما), the nominal or the particle one.
The clause «قلوبهم وجلة ...» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of آتوا.
The clause «أولئك يسارعون ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of inna.
The clause «يسارعون ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «هم لها سابقون» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يسارعون [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, an emphasising ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida) of the fāʿil of يسارعون.].
The clause «لا نكلّف ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause إنّ الذين.
The clause «لدينا كتاب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا نكلّف.
The clause «ينطق ...» is in the position of the nominative, a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب.
The clause «هم لا يظلمون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا نكلّف [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the generality of "soul".]..
The clause «لا يظلمون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the fourth mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(وجلة): feminine of وجل, an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from وجل يوجل, of the bāb of فرح; its pattern is فعلة. See also verse (52) of al-Ḥijr.

safi-cedvel:63-63.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) is for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī) [Note: A return to the states of the unbelievers mentioned in His saying أيحسبون أنّ ما نمدّهم ...; accordingly, the clauses from His saying إنّ الذين up to His saying هم لا يظلمون are a parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ).]; (في غمرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (قلوبهم); (من هذا) is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (غمرة); (لهم) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أعمال); (من دون) is attached to a naʿt of (أعمال); (لها) is attached to (عاملون) [Note: The lām may be for strengthening (li-l-taqwiya), and the pronoun the object of the active participle عاملون..].
The clause «قلوبهم في غمرة ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «لهم أعمال ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هم لها عاملون» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (لهم), or of الأعمال because it is qualified, and the governor (ʿāmil) of the ḥāl is the "being settled" (al-istiqrār).

safi-cedvel:64-67.t:
* I'rab:
(حتّى) is an inceptive particle (ḥarf ibtidāʾ); (بالعذاب) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of مترفيهم, and (الباء) is for accompaniment (mulābasa); (إذا) is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
The clause «أخذنا ...» is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «هم يجأرون» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
The clause «يجأرون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هم.
65- (لا) is prohibitive, making jussive (nāhiya jāzima), and the sign of the verb's jussive is the deletion of the nūn; (اليوم) is attached to (تجأروا); (منّا) is attached to the verb (تنصرون) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of تمنعون ("you are protected"), and (الواو) in (تنصرون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «لا تجأروا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying..
The clause «إنّكم.. لا تنصرون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا تنصرون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of inna.
66- (قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), and the nāʾib fāʿil of (تتلى) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي, i.e. "My verses"; (عليكم) is attached to (تتلى); (الفاء) is a conjunction; (على أعقابكم) is attached to (تنكصون) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of تنكصون; this is the choice of Abū al-Baqāʾ.].
The clause «كانت آياتي تتلى ...» has no grammatical position, an explanation (taʿlīl) of the absence of help.
The clause «تتلى عليكم» is in the position of the accusative, the khabar of كانت.
The clause «كنتم ... تنكصون» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause كانت آياتي تتلى.
The clause «تنكصون» is in the position of the accusative, the khabar of كنتم.
67- (مستكبرين) is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تنكصون, accusative (manṣūba), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ; (به) is attached to (مستكبرين) [Note: This is if the pronoun refers to the Qur'an or to the Prophet, and the bāʾ is causal (sababiyya).. if the pronoun refers to the Sacred House, the preposition phrase is attached to (سامرا).]; (سامرا) is a ḥāl, accusative, of the fāʿil of تنكصون or of the pronoun in مستكبرين [Note: It is in the singular form because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the form of an active participle, like العاقبة, or a singular in the place of a plural..
See the Morphology.].
The clause «تهجرون» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تنكصون, or of the pronoun in (سامرا), because it has the sense of a group.

* Morphology:
(سامرا): it was said to be a quasi-plural noun (ism jamʿ) in the sense of "those who converse at night"; it was said to be a maṣdar that came on the pattern of the active participle, like العاقبة and العافية; and it was said to be the place of night conversation; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
- The kinds of «حتى»:
حتى comes in several kinds:
a- Inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya) حتى. b- حتى which enters upon the imperfect verb, and it is of two types:
1- حتى which makes the imperfect verb accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after it.
2- حتى which enters upon the imperfect verb and leaves it nominative.
c- حتى can be a preposition, as in «حَتَّى مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ». d- It can be a conjunction, and it has three conditions.
An important observation:
All the kinds of حتى mentioned are for the end of the goal (intihāʾ al-ghāya), except the inceptive one.
A second observation: when the interrogative «ما» is joined to the prepositional «حتى», its alif is deleted because of the preposition's entering upon it, as in «حتام» نحلم والآخرون يجهلون ("Till when shall we dream while the others are ignorant?").
We return to the verse we are dealing with, and the i'rab of حتى in it: «حَتَّى إِذا أَخَذْنا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِالْعَذابِ» etc. حتى is «inceptive», and it is a particle with no grammatical position; it enters upon the nominal clause, as in the saying of Jarīr:
فما زالت القتلى تمجّ دماءها ... بدجلة حتى ماء دجلة أشكل
(The slain kept spurting their blood into the Tigris, until the water of the Tigris was tinged red.)
And it enters upon verbal clauses, as in the saying of Ḥassān:
يغشون حتى ما تهر كلابهم ... لا يسألون عن السواد المقبل
(They are so visited that their dogs no longer bark; they do not ask about the approaching crowd.)

safi-cedvel:99-100.t:
* I'rab:
(حتّى) a particle of commencement (ḥarf ibtidāʾ). (أحدهم) a fronted direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative. (الموت) agent (fāʿil), nominative. (ربّ) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (93) of this sūra.] The latent agent pronoun in (ارجعون) is for respect (plural of majesty), the (النون) is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the omitted (الياء) is a direct object.
Clause: «جاء أحدهم الموت ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.. The clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis have no grammatical position, being resumptive.
Clause: «قال» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
Clause: «النداء: ربّ ... » has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, to emphasize the supplication.
Clause: «ارجعون» is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech (maqūl al-qawl).
100- (في ما) attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (صالحا) [Note: it involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "a righteous deed existing in compensation for what I left behind".], and (ما) is a relative noun whose returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. «تركته». (كلّا) is a particle of rebuke and reproof. The pronoun in (إنّها) refers back to His saying (ربّ ارجعون). (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) - or conjunctive. (من ورائهم) is attached to an omitted predicate (khabar) placed first, for the subject (mubtadaʾ) (برزخ). (إلى يوم) is attached to an adjective of (برزخ). The (الواو) in (يبعثون) is the deputy agent (nāʾib al-fāʿil).
Clause: «لعلّي أعمل ... » has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
Clause: «أعمل صالحا ... » has no position in the nominative, as the predicate of لعلّ. [Translator's note: the source reads «لا محلّ رفع» without «لها»; translated as written, apparently meaning "is in the position of a nominative".]
Clause: «تركت ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
Clause: «إنّها كلمة ... » has no grammatical position, being a justification for the preceding rebuke.
Clause: «هو قائلها ... » is in the position of a nominative, an adjective of كلمة.
Clause: «من ورائهم برزخ» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun (هو) [Note: the returning link came in the plural to indicate the likes of those who say this word.. It is also permissible that the clause be conjoined to the causal clause, having no position.].
Clause: «يبعثون» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.

* Morphology:
(برزخ): a name for the barrier or veil between two things. It is said that its origin is «برزه» - with hāʾ - and it was Arabized. Here it is what stands between a person and the return that he wishes for. Its pattern is فعلل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and on the first lām.

* Benefits:
- The word (al-kalima):
Just as it is applied to the single word, which the grammarians divide into three kinds: noun, verb and particle, so the ancients also applied it, as a technical usage, to an expression composed of several words, or to a subject composed of several sentences or expressions.
Evidence for this is
the saying of the Messenger (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): "The truest word a poet ever spoke is the word of Labīd:
«ألا كل شيء ما خلا الله باطل»"
(Truly, everything other than Allah is vain.)
and their saying: "The best word is the word of the testimony of faith." By this they mean «لا إله إلا الله محمد رسول الله».

safi-cedvel:101-105.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive. (في الصور) deputy agent, in the position of a nominative. (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (لا) is the lā of generic negation. (أنساب) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative. (بينهم) an adverbial (ẓarf), accusative, attached to the predicate of lā. (يومئذ) an adverbial, accusative - or indeclinable on the fatḥa - attached to the omitted predicate; the tanwīn is a substitute for an omitted clause, i.e. "on the day when the Trumpet is blown". (الواو) is conjunctive. (لا) is negative.
Clause: «نفخ ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.. The clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis have no grammatical position, being resumptive.
Clause: «لا أنساب بينهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
Clause: «لا يتساءلون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis clause.
102- (الفاء) is a conjunctive fāʾ of consequence (ʿāṭifa tafrīʿiyya). (من) is a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (هم) is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: or a detached pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ whose predicate is المفلحون, the nominal clause being the predicate of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.], (المفلحون) predicate of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
Clause: «من ثقلت موازينه ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause (فإذا نفخ ... ).
Clause: «ثقلت موازينه ... » is in the position of a nominative, predicate of the mubtadaʾ (من).
Clause: «أولئك.. المفلحون» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
103- (الواو) is conjunctive. (من خفّت.. أولئك الذين) is like its counterpart.. (في جهنّم) is attached to the second predicate (خالدون) [Note: it is permissible that خالدون be the predicate of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هم, and the clause a substitute (badal) for the ṣila clause, having no position.] Clause: «من خفّت موازينه» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «من ثقلت».
Clause: «خفّت موازينه ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
Clause: «خسروا ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
104- (وجوههم) a fronted direct object, accusative. (فيها) attached to (كالحون), the predicate.
Clause: «تلفح.. النار» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in (خالدون).
Clause: «هم فيها كالحون» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
105- (الهمزة) is for rebuking - or denying - interrogation. The deputy agent of the verb (تتلى) is a pronoun referring to (آياتي). (عليكم) is attached to (تتلى). (الفاء) is conjunctive. (بها) is attached to (تكذّبون).
Clause: «لم تكن آياتي ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech of an implied saying.
Clause: «تتلى ... » is in the position of an accusative, predicate of تكن.
Clause: «كنتم بها تكذّبون ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the quoted speech.
Clause: «تكذّبون ... » is in the position of an accusative, predicate of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(أنساب): plural of نسب, a noun meaning kinship; its pattern is فعل, and it has the form of a maṣdar.
(كالحون): plural of كالح, one whose lips have drawn back, the upper lifted and the lower slack. It is an active participle from the triliteral verb كلح; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
The art of the pointed hint (fann al-tankīt):
In His saying, the Exalted, «فَلا أَنْسابَ بَيْنَهُمْ», by negating genealogies - which do exist - He intended something else, for a subtle point. For genealogies are established and cannot properly be negated; the Arabs used to boast of them in this world. Yet He inclined to negate them, either because they are voided in the Hereafter, since mutual severance occurs among them and they disperse, punished or rewarded; or because by the negation He intended an omitted attribute of the genealogies, i.e. that they are not counted upon, since they vanish altogether and are voided by the disappearance of compassion and affection, owing to the excess of breathlessness and exhaustion and the dominion of bewilderment over them.

safi-cedvel:106-107.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi. (علينا) attached to (غلبت). (الواو) is conjunctive.
Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
Clause: «ربّنا ... » has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, to implore mercy.
Clause: «غلبت علينا شقوتنا» is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech [Note: it is permissible that it be the response to the vocative, having no position, and the vocative clause with its response be the quoted speech, in the position of an accusative.].
Clause: «كنّا ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause غلبت.
107- (ربّنا) is like the first. (منها) attached to (أخرجنا). The first (الفاء) is conjunctive and the second links to the apodosis.
Clause: «ربّنا (الثانية)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive within the scope of the saying, for emphasis.
Clause: «أخرجنا ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
Clause: «إن عدنا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response to the vocative.
Clause: «إنّا ظالمون ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(شقوتنا): a maṣdar denoting manner and kind, from the triliteral verb شقي; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:108-111.t:
* I'rab:
(فيها) attached to (اخسؤوا). (الواو) is conjunctive. (لا) is a prohibitive, jussive lā, and the (النون) in (تكلّمون) is the nūn of protection; the (ياء) of the first person, the direct object, has been omitted for the verse-ending rhyme (fāṣila).
Clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
Clause: «اخسؤوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech.
Clause: «لا تكلّمون ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the quoted speech.
109- The pronoun in (إنّه) is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the noun of إنّ. (من عبادي) attached to an adjective of (فريق). (الفاء) links to the apodosis of an implied condition. (لنا) attached to (اغفر). (الواو) is parenthetical - or circumstantial.
Clause: «إنّه كان ... » has no grammatical position, being a justification.
Clause: «كان فريق ... » is in the position of a nominative, predicate of إنّ.
Clause: «يقولون ... » is in the position of an accusative, predicate of كان.
Clause: «ربّنا آمنّا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech.
Clause: «آمنّا ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
Clause: «اغفر ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if You accept our faith, then forgive us" [Note: or "if You call us to account, then forgive us".].
Clause: «ارحمنا ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause اغفر.
Clause: «أنت خير ... » has no grammatical position, being parenthetical [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the agent of ارحمنا.].
110- (الفاء) is conjunctive, and the (الواو) in (اتخذتموهم) is redundant (zāʾida), a lengthening of the vowel of the mīm..
and (هم) is the first direct object. (سخريّا) the second direct object, accusative. (حتّى) a particle of limit and of genitive. (ذكري) the second direct object, accusative, its governor being أنسوكم, and the sign of the accusative is the implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أنسوكم ... ) is in the position of a genitive after (حتّى), attached to (اتّخذتموهم).
(الواو) is conjunctive. (منهم) attached to (تضحكون).
Clause: «اتّخذتموهم ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause يقولون.
Clause: «أنسوكم ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-like relative (أن).
Clause: «كنتم ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أنسوكم.
Clause: «تضحكون» is in the position of an accusative, predicate of كنتم.
111- (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (جزيتهم). (ما) is a maṣdar particle.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما صبروا ... ) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (جزيتهم), and the (الباء) is causal.
(هم) is a pronoun borrowed for the accusative position, an emphasis of the pronoun that is the noun of أنّ [Note: it is permissible that it be a mubtadaʾ whose predicate is الفائزون, the nominal clause being the predicate of أنّ.] Clause: «إنّي جزيتهم ... » has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
Clause: «جزيتهم ... » is in the position of a nominative, predicate of إنّ. Clause: «صبروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم هم الفائزون) is in the position of an accusative, the second direct object, its governor being جزيتهم [Note: it is permissible that the second object be omitted, its implied form being (النعيم), in which case the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of a genitive by the lām of justification, attached to (جزيتهم).].

* Morphology:
(سخريّا): a maṣdar of سخر, meaning "he mocked". Its origin is السخر, and the doubled yāʾ was added for emphasis.. In al-Miṣbāḥ: "سخرت منه سخرا" (of the bāb تعب) means "I scoffed at him", and السخريّ with kasra is a dialectal variant of it. Its pattern is فعليّ, with kasra, then sukūn, then a doubled yāʾ.

* Benefits:
- «قالَ اخْسَؤُا فِيها»:
It appears that the letters khāʾ and sīn indicate abasement, humiliation and wretchedness. So when the first and second radicals of the verb are khāʾ and sīn, they indicate that, as in: خسئ, خسر, خسف, etc.
Whoever traces the characteristics of this language and the secrets of its letters will see wonders of benefits and countless subtleties; and in the longer works of al-Suyūṭī, al-Thaʿālibī, Ibn Jinnī and others there is what quenches thirst and soothes the heart.

safi-cedvel:112-112.t:
* I'rab:
The agent of (قال) is a latent pronoun referring to Allah the Exalted. (كم) is an interrogative noun, intended for reproach, in the position of an accusative adverb of time, attached to (لبثتم). (في الأرض) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of لبثتم. (عدد) the tamyīz of كم [Translator's note: the source reads «تمييزكم», apparently «تمييز كم»], accusative. (سنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
Clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
Clause: «لبثتم ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech.

* Benefits:
- «عَدَدَ سِنِينَ»:
A tamyīz for the interrogative «كم».
And سنين is attached to the sound masculine plural, and therefore it is genitive with yāʾ in place of the kasra.
We have already given a list of the nouns attached to this plural, so consult it in its proper places.

safi-cedvel:113-113.t:
* I'rab:
(يوما) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (لبثنا). (أو) a conjunction of doubt. (بعض) conjoined to (يوما), accusative. (الفاء) links to the apodosis of an implied condition.
Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
Clause: «لبثنا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech.
Clause: «اسأل ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the implied condition, i.e. "if you wish, then ask"..

* Morphology:
(العادّين): plural of العادّ, an active participle from the triliteral verb عدّ; its pattern is فاعل, and its ʿayn and lām are the same letter.

safi-cedvel:114-115.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) is negative. (إلّا) is for restriction. (قليلا) an adverb of time, accusative, because it is its adjective, i.e. "you stayed a small number of years" [Note: it is permissible that it be an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) standing in place of the maṣdar, being its adjective, i.e. "except a short stay".].
